title: Taking Band-Limited Maximum Likelihood to High Dimensions: Linear Memory, the Parametric Rate, and a Self-Tuning Cut-off
abstract: arXiv:2611.19011v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Band-limited maximum likelihood (BLML) estimates a density as the square of a band-limited function. The estimate is non-negative, and when the square root of the true density is band-limited its error falls at the parametric rate $n^{-1}$. Its algorithm bins the data, which is fast only in one or two dimensions: from three on every point has its own bin, the kernel system is dense, and memory grows as $n^2$, 40 GB at $10^5$ points. Whether the rate survives in higher dimension, where kernel estimators slow down, had not been tested. We study dense data, densities that fill their space, not data near a low-dimensional manifold. We show that the binned equations are the stationarity condition of a strictly convex objective and minimise it by block coordinate descent without forming the kernel matrix: memory is linear in $n$, a sweep costs $O(n^2 d)$ and a fit takes about ten, and one A100 GPU fits $10^6$ points in eight dimensions in ab

translated_title: 将带宽受限最大似然推向高维：线性内存、参数速率与自调节截断
translated_abstract: 带宽受限最大似然（BLML）将密度估计为一个带宽受限函数的平方。该估计是非负的，并且当真实密度的平方根为带宽受限时，其误差以参数速率 n^{-1} 下降。其算法通过数据分箱实现，但这仅在一维或二维下快速：从三维起，每个点都有自己独立的箱，核系统变为稠密，内存按 n² 增长——在 10⁵ 个点时达到 40 GB。该速率在高维（即核估计器变慢的场景）下是否仍然成立，此前从未被验证。我们研究的是稠密数据，即密度填满整个空间，而非接近低维流形的数据。我们证明分箱方程是一个严格凸目标函数的驻点条件，并通过块坐标下降法将其最小化，而无需构造核矩阵：内存关于 n 呈线性，一次扫描的代价为 O(n²d)，一次拟合约需十分钟，一块 A100 GPU 可在八维下拟合 10⁶ 个点……
tldr: 该论文证明分箱BLML方程是严格凸目标函数的驻点条件，并提出无需构造核矩阵的块坐标下降算法，实现了线性内存扩展与单卡GPU在八维下拟合百万级数据点，同时证明了参数速率 n⁻¹ 与自调节截断在高维中依然有效。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that the binned BLML equations are the stationarity condition of a strictly convex objective and minimizes them via block coordinate descent without forming the kernel matrix, achieving linear memory and fitting one million points in eight dimensions on a single A100 GPU, while the parametric rate and a self-tuning cut-off are shown to survive in high dimensions.
